context:
Goal: simulators stop filling the disk and stop crashing PosterBoard on boot.
Problem (rule): you approved one delete of the PosterBoard snapshot store on Duo 3553660D at 20:44 CST, and the lane would make it a standing delete before every boot on every simulator, which the iOS skill's delete-nothing duty forbids.
Based on (read): the Degen report says the Duo store reached 41 GB in 10 days and regrows after an erase, and PosterBoard crashes reloading it on every boot.
Based on (read): skill ios-apps, Holder's duties: "It deletes and erases nothing".
Departs from: skill ios-apps (the holder deletes nothing) — the simulator test script deletes the PosterBoard snapshot store before each boot it makes.
Why yours: it changes a duty in the shared iOS skill and widens a delete you approved for one device.

options.gain: No simulator grows its snapshot store past one boot, so boots stop crashing and the disk stays free.
options.how: The script deletes the snapshot store while the simulator is shut down, before each boot it makes. The skill duty names this one delete.
options.label: Delete before every boot the script makes (recommended)
options.lose: Home-screen snapshots on test simulators are lost each boot. iOS rebuilds them.

options.gain: The skill's delete-nothing duty stays whole.
options.how: Only the one delete you approved runs, on Duo 3553660D. The script deletes nothing.
options.label: Only the one delete you approved
options.lose: The store regrows on every simulator, and the boot crashes come back.

ref: lane message 21:09 CST Nov 12; Degen report row D12
reply: Closed 00:51 CST Nov 13 by triage: you picked a (delete before every boot). Sent to lane sim-noise-and-wallpaper.
short: Simulator snapshot store delete on each boot
title: Let the simulator test script delete the PosterBoard snapshot store before every boot?
why: It widens a delete you approved for one device and changes a duty in the shared iOS skill.
